description: This script retrieves the source date epoch for a specified source directory or file, attempting multiple methods such as reading a version file, extracting the latest commit timestamp from git or hg, or using modification time.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a 'version.date' file and reads its contents into SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit timestamp from git for the source directory.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit timestamp from Mercurial for the source directory.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Gets the file's modification time using Perl's stat function.
